titlePl: Ósmoklasista: Podróże — 36 haseł do gier LingoSpark
titleEn: Grade 8 English: Travel & Tourism — 36 terms for LingoSpark games
blurbPl: Lista na dział Podróżowanie i turystyka (ósmoklasista). Wklejasz do gier LingoSpark i od razu grasz — fiszki, bomba, aukcja, quiz na żywo.
blurbEn: A Grade-8 list for Travel & Tourism. Paste into LingoSpark games and play: Flashcards, Bomb, Auction, Live Quiz.

items.definitionEn: the act of travelling from one place to another
items.example: The train journey from Kraków to Gdańsk takes about six hours.

items.definitionEn: the place you are travelling to
items.example: Our destination is a small town on the coast.

items.definitionEn: the moment when a bus, train or plane leaves
items.example: The departure is at quarter past seven.

items.definitionEn: the moment when you reach a place
items.example: Please wait in the hall until the arrival of the coach.

items.definitionEn: a situation when something happens later than planned
items.example: There was a two-hour delay because of the snow.

items.definitionEn: the area beside the railway tracks where you wait
items.example: The train to Warsaw leaves from platform four.

items.definitionEn: the ticket you show before you get on a plane
items.example: Keep your boarding pass until you leave the airport.

items.definitionEn: the bags you take when you travel
items.example: Do not leave your luggage unattended at the station.

items.definitionEn: a large case with a handle for clothes
items.example: My suitcase was too heavy for the cabin.

items.definitionEn: a bag you carry on your back
items.example: A backpack is better than a suitcase for hiking.

items.definitionEn: to show your ticket and leave bags at the airport or hotel
items.example: We need to check in two hours before the flight.

items.definitionEn: when a plane leaves the ground
items.example: The plane will take off as soon as the runway is clear.

items.definitionEn: when a plane comes down to the ground
items.example: We will land in London at noon.

items.definitionEn: a ticket for going and coming back
items.example: A return ticket is cheaper than two singles.

items.definitionEn: a ticket for going one way only
items.example: I only need a single ticket because my uncle will drive me back.

items.definitionEn: to reserve a place to sleep in a hotel
items.example: Did you book a room for Friday night?

items.definitionEn: a small guest house that includes breakfast
items.example: We stayed in a bed and breakfast near the lake.

items.definitionEn: a place where you can put up a tent
items.example: The campsite has showers and a small shop.

items.definitionEn: visiting famous places as a tourist
items.example: We spent the morning sightseeing in the old town.

items.definitionEn: a book with maps and tips for tourists
items.example: The guidebook recommended a cheap café by the river.

items.definitionEn: a small object you buy to remember a place
items.example: She bought a fridge magnet as a souvenir.

items.definitionEn: a holiday where travel and hotel are booked together
items.example: A package holiday is easier if you do not like planning.

items.definitionEn: to travel to another country
items.example: They want to go abroad for the first time this summer.

items.definitionEn: to not know where you are
items.example: Tourists often get lost when they ignore the map.

items.definitionEn: a long line of cars that cannot move
items.example: We sat in a traffic jam for forty minutes.

items.definitionEn: a place where you buy fuel for a car
items.example: There is a petrol station just after the roundabout.

items.definitionEn: a list of times when trains leave
items.example: Check the train timetable before you go to the station.

items.definitionEn: a boat that carries people and cars across water
items.example: We took the ferry from Dover to Calais.

items.definitionEn: a comfortable bus for long journeys
items.example: The school trip left by long-distance coach at six in the morning.

items.definitionEn: the corridor between seats
items.example: I prefer an aisle seat so I can stretch my legs.

items.definitionEn: a seat next to the window
items.example: She always asks for a window seat on the plane.

items.definitionEn: stopped and not happening as planned
items.example: Our flight was cancelled because of the storm.

items.definitionEn: a town or hotel area designed for holidays
items.example: The ski resort is busy in February.

items.definitionEn: a famous building or place that helps you recognise a city
items.example: The castle is the most famous landmark in the city.

items.definitionEn: to travel by asking drivers to take you for free
items.example: It is not safe to hitchhike alone at night.

items.definitionEn: travelling by road or rail, not by air
items.example: We went overland from Poland to Italy by train.
